origin.target: Gateway origin, normally port 8080; never upstream LoRA origin

auth.admin_required_when: Gateway LLM_ADMIN_TOKEN is nonempty; applies to all five endpoints
auth.owner_token_returned: 201 create response only; no lookup or reissue

identifiers.client_id: required fresh string; no coercion or default; retained duplicates return 409
identifiers.session_id: opaque create response value; copy unchanged

errors.400: invalid client_id, settings, or unknown keys
errors.409: existing reservation, active/queued work, training monitor, or retained duplicate client_id
errors.503: Docker unavailable or required safety prerequisites disabled

heartbeat.refreshes_deadline: idle only, capped by original hard deadline

generate.body_forwarding: byte-for-byte; no adapter or test-mode policy
generate.response: upstream body and HTTP status unchanged; synthetic Gateway errors use detail:string

errors.400: missing/invalid operation ID or invalid session-header route use; upstream validation may also return 400
errors.404: unknown/missing session ID; upstream missing adapter may also return 404
errors.409: duplicate operation, session busy/closing/expired, or upstream conflict
errors.504: hard deadline, cancellation, or upstream timeout

delete.retry: same capability may retry failed cleanup; poll status; never substitute generic reservation release

status_shape.operations: array of operation_shape; insertion order; not a map; no last_operation field

generation_success_shape.adapter_name: string or null; Site TARIC test:true requires taric-v1-20260917-2

proof.idle_proven: session open, unexpired, current reservation, no active owned worker; not physical VRAM-empty proof
proof.reclaim_verified: closed/expired session stopped and VRAM reclaim verified; unrelated work may subsequently start
proof.http_status_200: remote completion only; does not prove caller received output
proof.operation_absent: not non-dispatch proof: original body receipt may still be pending

reconciliation.before_send: persist operation_id; identify by operations.find(op => op.operation_id === persistedId)
reconciliation.http_abort_after_acceptance: Gateway-owned task and lease continue; caller abort does not cancel
reconciliation.pending_running_uncertain: poll authenticated status; do not submit next case
reconciliation.matching_terminal_completed_and_idle_pro: next case may proceed with fresh ID; lost-output case remains failed even for HTTP 200
reconciliation.reclaim_verified: old session work ended; fresh session admission required for next case
reconciliation.operation_absent: close owned session and verify reclaim before new admission
reconciliation.duplicate_409: no re-execution; count failed attempt; reconcile original ID

success_checks: received HTTP success and valid generation JSON
content/raw_content strings, tool_calls array, usage token counts

legacy_hold_recovery.implemented_in: Site; this file specifies integration behavior, not a new Gateway endpoint
legacy_hold_recovery.atomic_remote_admission: POST create 201; idle_proven=true; no intervening await between conflict checks and reservation installation
legacy_hold_recovery.clear_condition: compare-and-set old hold to new owned session while Mongo lease and unexpired owned reservation remain valid; every subsequent dispatch capability-owned
legacy_hold_recovery.ambiguous_create_action: keep hold; no capability recovery; no fresh-ID retry to recover ownership
legacy_hold_recovery.manual_alternative: continuous admission fence over all producers, cancel/drain pending work, verify remote completion and container/VRAM idle under fence, Mongo compare-and-set
legacy_hold_recovery.limitations: scheduled Gateway traffic and startup fence assumed; direct upstream work or unfenceable producers require manual recovery
